Rhea (People Ops): Quick note  launching a small pilot for this cycle: 'shadow reviewers' in calibration to help spot bias and speed up questions. Details below.
Tom (Eng Manager): Shadow reviewers = who? Peers or HR folks?
Rhea (People Ops): Peers from other teams + one HRBP. They read packets (no voting) and add a 1-line observation where they see inconsistent rubric use or missing evidence. Goal is signal-only, not to change ratings.
Ivy (HRBP): Will shadow reviewers see promotion/comp-impact rows? Access control?
Rhea (People Ops): Yes, they will see full packet but access is read-only. Comp-impact rows are visible to Comp Ops and VPs as usual. Shadow notes are private to People Ops + packet owner for now.
Ken (Comp Ops): Payroll timing Q: for EMEA folks the payroll cutoff differs. Can we confirm global cutoff dates so managers can advise ICs correctly?
Asha (People Ops): Good call. Global payroll cutoffs for retro changes this cycle:
- US: 2026-06-07 17:00 PT
- EMEA: 2026-06-02 18:00 GMT
- APAC: 2026-06-04 12:00 SGT
Please route any urgent payroll-impact appeals to comp-ops with country flagged.
Tom (Eng Manager): If a shadow reviewer flags a missing artifact, what's the follow-up? Do we allow a short supplement window pre-calibration?
Rhea (People Ops): Yes  we'll run a 24-hour supplement window after the preflight check (preflight runs Mon 05/11 morning). Shadow flags create an auto-ticket to the manager to add docs within 24 hours. After that window the exec packet freezes.
Ivy (HRBP): Any change to exceptions/limited review rules?
Rhea (People Ops): No rule changes. Reminder: >50% leave = limited review by default; converted contractors included if conversion effective <= 04/10; exceptions via form.
hr-bot: Reminder: self-assessments due 05/05 23:59 PT. Exception form: https://redwood.company/hr/exceptions
Tom (Eng Manager): How do managers opt out of the pilot? Some teams are small and don't want cross-team reads.
Rhea (People Ops): Opt-out allowed but ask product teams not to opt-out for promo-heavy groups. To opt out, fill quick opt-out form by 05/03; default is opt-in.
Ken (Comp Ops): One more ask: when submitting comp-impact tags, include estimated delta (annualized) and whether it's base/bonus/equity. Helps reducers triage quickly.
Asha (People Ops): We'll add a small column in the packet template for "estimated comp delta" and a checkbox for "requires VP review".
Tom (Eng Manager): Thanks 44d will brief leads and confirm opt-outs by Friday.
Rhea (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll publish a 1-pager about the shadow reviewer pilot and the global payroll cutoffs this afternoon.
